name: namrop
title: Namrop
description: The namrop.com register: abyssal violet-black inks, ivory text, gold frames, ghost cyan, electric violet. Restrained mythic — the lighthouse-and-question-star site whose slant grammar GC already carries (namrop is the SLANT donor, so this theme is natively slanted). Donor of record: namrop-site app/globals.css, read-only.

notes.roles: Mapped from the donor's own lens grammar (app/globals.css), not by decoration: structure = gold-bright #e0ba68 — the default --lens-accent and the hue of every hairline/frame (--line is rgba(216,174,96,.26)); the bordered cut IS namrop's structural voice. info = --cyan #5fc3d1, the technical-lens accent — the ghost cyan that carries quiet data. stability = #b7e4a8, the plainspoken-lens green — the site's single green, the calm at-rest register. threshold = --gold #b98742, the deep ceremonial gold kept apart from the bright structural gold (the same gold/gold-deep split johannah uses) so gates read as weightier, rarer gold. intent = --violet-electric #c283e4, the mythic-lens accent — the electric violet/fuchsia that marks the mythic, human hand.
notes.violation: DRAFTED, keeper-tunable: the donor site has no alarm channel and no red anywhere in its palette. #be2d4b is derived from --wine #3f1434 by lifting lightness to legibility on the ink-deep base and rotating the hue (0.876 → 0.965 HLS) out of the violet quadrant — a plain lightness lift of wine lands in fuchsia territory and would read as intent's family, which violation may never do. Sacred, never decorative.
notes.surfaces: bg = --ink-deep #05010a, fg = --ivory #f2e7d5, panel/panel-raised are the solid equivalents of --panel rgba(24,12,32,.78) and --panel-strong rgba(31,15,41,.94); line is --line verbatim; shade is --shadow verbatim; muted = --ivory-muted; muted-alt = #8f5aa0, the attested quiet plum; bg-deep = #030107, the body gradient's darkest stop; scrollbar thumb = attested bronze #5b381f with deep-gold hover — quiet structure, never an accent (keeper-ruled 2026-08-29).
notes.shape: namrop IS the slant donor — its grammar (diagonal + octagon clips, cut scale, --cut-border-all) went upstream into GC's shape-slant overlay (see namrop-site design/governed-cognition-2026-08-30.md). Native shape is slanted; the radius scale is zero at every tier because the site has no round geometry (hard_edged, so the picker offers hard and slanted only — conformance's rounded/hard cross-checks pass a zero-scale slanted native as-is; no new rule was needed). The site's whole identity is bordered cuts, so consumers of this theme are the natural users of data-gc-line-treatment="border"; the lift color stays a faint gold wash for the default treatment.
notes.type: All three families are the donor's own system stacks verbatim (body 'Avenir Next'/'Segoe UI', display Georgia serif, mono the --mono stack) — nothing to vendor, so font licensing is moot. Avenir Next is an Apple system font; non-Apple platforms fall through to Segoe UI / system-ui exactly as the site does.
notes.motion: Restrained mythic: slower than the cockpits, more present than johannah — pulse 2.4s at 0.55 amplitude. Channels tunable, never removable.
notes.sets: LANE-DRAFTED, KEEPER-TUNABLE. series-rank is a ten-ink ramp entirely from attested donor values (ghost cyan, beam cyan rgba(35,215,255) solid, violet-electric, plum-bright, pale orchid, gold-bright, gold, star-gold #f4d486, plainspoken green, quiet plum). harness: claude_code = ghost cyan, secondary = plum-bright, hermes = gold-bright, opencode = violet-electric. session-type: main = green (the at-rest lane), cron = gold, delegated = plum-bright.
notes.background: assets-src/namrop/background.webp is the site's real art: public/hero/namrop-question-star-cyberpunk-hero.png (the question-star lighthouse with the violet beam), dimmed 52% toward ink-deep #05010a and re-encoded webp q72 at 1536x1024 for interface-background subtlety.
